system_name: Fictional Character + Bedroom Visual Continuity System
purpose: A reusable visual bible for another AI agent to recreate the same fictional adult woman and her bedroom across many camera angles, outfits, and scenes.

character.visual_archetype: Vietnamese/East Asian-looking young adult woman, realistic rather than model-perfect

face.overall: soft oval face with a slightly tapered lower face
identity_landmarks: subtle asymmetry; do not make the face mathematically perfect
visible cheek dimple when smiling or making a slight smile

skin.texture: real human skin with visible pores and very fine texture

beauty_marks.rule: retain the established small facial/body beauty marks visible in the reference; never invent a new prominent mole unless explicitly requested

hair.length: long, extending well below the shoulders toward mid-back/waist
hair.texture: mostly straight with soft natural bends/waves and flyaways
hair.front: long face-framing strands / loose curtain-like pieces
hair.rule: hair length, density and general silhouette are locked across views

body.silhouette: slender adult feminine silhouette with natural proportions
body.rule: avoid exaggerated hourglass, plastic-surgery proportions, or anatomically inconsistent limbs
body.skin: retain realistic texture and small tonal variations

chest.placement: center-upper chest, directly below the necklace
chest.motif: butterfly-like central motif with fine-line ornamental/organic detailing
chest.scale: clearly visible and larger than a tiny minimalist tattoo
chest.rule: keep centered and below necklace; do not move it to the neck

upper_arm.placement: visible tattoo work on upper arm/shoulder region

back.placement: large tattoo composition visible across upper/mid back in rear views
back.rule: rear-view continuity is important; do not replace it with a different unrelated tattoo

tattoos.continuity_note: The reference collage contains stylized/generated tattoo details that are not perfectly identical from frame to frame. Treat the motif family and placement zones as locked; create a future master tattoo reference sheet to lock exact linework.

jewelry.necklace: thin delicate silver-toned chain with a small pendant
jewelry.rule: pendant sits above the chest tattoo
jewelry.other: minimal understated jewelry; avoid adding large statement pieces unless requested

wardrobe_style.core_aesthetic: romantic feminine bedroom wardrobe with lace, soft textures and vintage-inspired details
wardrobe_style.rule: clothing should look wearable and physically plausible, with real folds, seams and fabric texture

room.mood: warm, intimate, lived-in, creative, slightly nostalgic

architecture.floor: warm medium wood or wood-look floor
architecture.window: large window with visible city lights at night in some views
architecture.air_conditioner: wall-mounted AC unit above/near the main room area

layout.bed: large bed positioned as a dominant anchor on one side of the room
layout.desk: dark desk/workstation near the wall/window area
layout.chair: dark office/task chair at the desk
layout.wardrobe: open wardrobe / closet with multiple hanging rails and shelving
layout.mirror: full-length mirror used for outfit selfies
layout.storage: drawers and open shelves for clothing, shoes and bags

decor.photo_wall: dense collage of small personal photographs/postcards covering a significant wall area
decor.shelves: small decorative objects, bags, keepsakes and personal items
decor.lighting: small warm lamps / vanity-like practical lights
decor.bed: soft patterned bedding in a pale blue/white family
decor.soft_objects: small plush/soft decorative objects may appear on or near the bed

wardrobe.organization: clothes grouped on rails, folded items in drawers, shoes and bags on shelves
wardrobe.rule: wardrobe should feel abundant but curated, not like a retail store

photography.style: high-end smartphone photography / realistic casual lifestyle photography
photography.realism: photorealistic, natural skin and fabric texture
lens_language: phone selfie perspective for mirror/selfie shots
preferred_views: wide shot from corner of room

lighting.base: warm practical lamps mixed with soft ambient room light
lighting.night: cooler city/window light can mix with warm interior light

camera_rules: do not warp room geometry to fit the subject
show enough environmental context in wide shots
maintain consistent left/right placement of tattoos and room objects

negative_constraints: Do not make skin porcelain-smooth or airbrushed.
Do not change face shape between shots.
Do not remove the chest, arm or back tattoo zones.
Do not relocate the chest tattoo above the necklace.
Do not invent large facial features, exaggerated eyes, or doll-like proportions.
Do not change the room into a luxury hotel, fashion showroom or minimalist studio.
Do not randomly rearrange the bed, desk, wardrobe and mirror between adjacent shots.
Do not add dramatic cinematic fog, excessive bokeh, or glossy influencer filters.
Do not create inconsistent clothing physics or impossible mirror reflections.

agent_prompt_template.identity_lock: Use the Character Bible as immutable identity context. Preserve face landmarks, hair silhouette, tattoo placement, jewelry, skin texture and body proportions.
agent_prompt_template.environment_lock: Use the Room Bible as immutable environment context. Preserve bed, desk, wardrobe, mirror, photo wall, door, window, AC and major prop relationships.
agent_prompt_template.instruction: Only change scene variables. Never redesign the character or room unless the request explicitly says to unlock a specific element.

recommended_next_assets: character front / 3-4 view / side / rear turnaround sheet
face close-up sheet showing eyes, nose, lips, dimples, beauty marks and skin texture
tattoo close-up sheet for chest, arm and back linework
master_reference_plan.reason: The current generated collage establishes the design language well, but several small details vary between generated frames. A dedicated master reference set is the safest way to make another agent reproduce the character and room consistently.
